proposal.title: Improve immediate style rotation tracking and zero-view metric rate evaluation
proposal.reason: Tracking last_editorial_style ensures strict anti-repetition of consecutive editorial styles, while adding raw metric fallbacks in rate evaluation prevents experiment scoring from collapsing to zero when view counts are missing.
